claims: The Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion officially releases on May 22, 2026.
Preorders for the Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion are currently available on the Pokemon Center.
Build & Battle tournaments take place from May 9th through May 17th, 2026.
The Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion has a digital release on Pokémon TCG Live on May 21, 2026.
The Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion features over 120 cards.
The Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Chaos Rising expansion focuses on Mega Evolution Pokémon ex such as Mega Greninja ex, Mega Pyroar ex, Mega Floette ex, and Mega Dragalge ex.
